rule: the 5 datasets with n_train<100 on which RocketPFN loses most to HC2, measured on the completed 92x30 sweep. Selecting on our own outcome biases toward improvement (regression to the mean), so a win here is a hint to confirm on unselected datasets, not a result.
control: k=1000 is already measured for these datasets at resamples 0-4 in results/rocketpfn/, so the comparison is paired on identical splits.
